# Ledger partitions and invariant checks

> Two maintenance jobs that pre-create ledger partitions monthly and verify daily that all bookkeeping entries sum to zero.

_Part of [domain/payments](../../units/domain/payments.md)_

The ledger stores financial transactions as immutable [`LedgerEntry`](recording-money-in-ledger.md) rows in a double-entry bookkeeping system where every journal must sum to zero. Two scheduled jobs keep this system healthy and performant. The `ledger.ensure-partitions` job runs at 3 AM on the 1st of each month and pre-creates partitions for the months ahead by calling the `ledger_ensure_partitions()` SQL function. This prevents new inserts from accidentally landing in a default catch-all partition when they don't match any existing date range. By default it creates 4 months worth of partitions. The `ledger.verify-invariants` job runs daily at 2:15 AM and acts as a belt-and-braces check on top of the commit-time trigger: it queries the entire [`LedgerEntry`](recording-money-in-ledger.md) table to confirm the book balance is zero, and also checks that no journal from the last 2 days is unbalanced (each journal's entries should sum to zero). If any violation is found—like entries inserted by a manual script with the trigger disabled—it increments a counter, logs an error, and pages someone on-call.

**Look at:** [`LedgerMaintenanceJobs` in ledger-maintenance.jobs.ts](../../../../packages/backend/libs/domains/payments/infra/ledger-maintenance.jobs.ts#L16)

## Pieces

- Monthly partition pre-creation job: Pre-creates ledger partitions months ahead so new inserts land in the correct date-range partition and never overflow into a default partition.
- [Daily invariant verification job](verify-invariants-job.md): Confirms that all ledger entries sum to zero across the whole book and within each recent journal, catching imbalances that may have bypassed the commit-time trigger.

## What it touches

| Kind | Name | How |
|---|---|---|
| database | `LedgerEntry table` | Read to sum all amounts (invariant: must equal zero) and to identify unbalanced journals from the last 2 days |
| database | `Ledger partitions` | Created monthly via `ledger_ensure_partitions`() SQL function to pre-allocate date ranges and prevent inserts from overflowing into a default partition |
| job | `ledger.ensure-partitions` | Scheduled to run at 3 AM on the 1st of each month; registered on bootstrap via [`JobsService`](../../../../packages/backend/libs/infrastructure/jobs/jobs.service.ts#L14) |
| job | `ledger.verify-invariants` | Scheduled to run at 2:15 AM daily; registered on bootstrap via [`JobsService`](../../../../packages/backend/libs/infrastructure/jobs/jobs.service.ts#L14) |
| other | `ledger_invariant_violations_total counter` | Incremented when the book total is not zero or when unbalanced journals are found in the last 2 days |

## Watch out

- The partition job creates `monthsAhead + 1` partitions (default 4 months, not 3); older data is not re-partitioned
- The verify job has a 5-minute lease (`leaseMs`: 300_000)—if a previous run takes longer, the next scheduled run is skipped entirely
- Only journals from the last 2 days are checked for balance; older imbalances depend entirely on the commit-time trigger
- Invariant violations trigger on-call pages (O-01), making even rare edge cases like a manual insert with the trigger disabled into potential incidents
